India's Monsoon Season Becomes More Extremes Due to Climate Change

The Indian monsoon season has been experiencing more extreme weather patterns due to climate change. This is attributed to the impact of global warming and carbon emissions on the region's climate. The changes in the monsoon pattern are affecting various parts of India, leading to severe rainfall events. Understanding the causes of these changes is crucial for predicting future weather patterns.
